description:
ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR AND SIDE INFILL EXTENSION TO SIDE BOUNDARY, REAR PORCH WITH NEW SIDE WINDOW AND SIDE GATE ACCESS, A FIRST FLOOR SIDE EXTENSION, REMOVAL OF EXISTING CHIMNEY, A HIP TO GABLE MAIN ROOF EXTENSION OVER FIRST FLOOR EXTENSION (UNDER CONSTRUCTION AS APPROVED UNDER APPLICATION REF 22/P3333)
A NEW ROOF LIGHT TO THE ROOF OF THE SIDE EXTENSION AND A  REAR ROOF DORMER EXTENSION WITH INTERNAL ALTERATIONS.
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">Tree Protection: The details and measures for the protection
of the existing trees as specified in the hereby approved documents ‘ TREE
SURVEY, ARBORICULTURAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT AND ARBORICULTURAL METHOD STATEMENT 11th
April 2025 (rev3) and Tree Protection Plan drawing’ shall be fully complied
with. The methods for the protection of the existing trees shall fully accord
with all of the measures specified in the report and shall be installed prior
to the commencement of any site works and shall remain in place until the
conclusion of all site works. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">

</p><p class="MsoNormal">Reason: To protect and safeguard the existing trees in
accordance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy G7
of the London Plan 2021, policies 015.1, 015.2 and 015.4 of the Local Plan
2024.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

Materials to be Approved - Notwithstanding the materials annotated on the approved drawings or application form, prior to the commencement of works to the rear dormer, details and samples of all external materials and finishes to be used in its construction shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy D4 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024 .
